summary: A weekly Sunday-evening open jam on the taproom stage at Pisgah Brewing Company in Black Mountain, run by the venue itself rather than a standing community. Each week's listing names a different rotating host or featured touring act (Spiro & Friends, Alex Bazemore, etc.) and explicitly invites 'any and all musicians' to sit in, with no membership, dues, sign-up form, or dedicated group page anywhere in the descriptions.

evidence.note: Description says 'Any and all musicians are welcome to come sit in' and 'The Jam is hosted by rotating special guests' with touring artists featured each week — classic drop-in open jam framing, not a member roster.

Across the five recurring listings the named host changes week to week (Spiro & Friends vs. unspecified 'rotating special guests'), and one unit is literally titled 'Sunday Jam with Spiro n Friends!' while others carry no host name at all, showing the jam is a venue-programmed slot, not one fixed act or crew.
No listing anywhere mentions members, a sign-up sheet, dues, a Facebook group, Meetup, Discord, or any organizing body other than Pisgah Brewing Company.

Etix ticketing shows the same 'Sunday Jam' slot also branded under a different named host (Alex Bazemore), confirming the series rotates its featured host rather than being run by one persistent group.

Web search for 'Spiro & Friends' turned up no dedicated band, page, or community for that name in Asheville — only that Spiro Nicolopoulos is one of several rotating hosts for this brewery-run jam night.

Pisgah Brewing's own site presents Sunday Jam as one of many recurring in-house show slots (alongside e.g. a Tuesday 'Bluegrass Open Jam'), i.e. venue programming rather than an independent club's regular meeting.
